how_it_was_created: Deterministic (no-LLM) phase-level extractor: data/new_aep_workflow_scrap/extract_workflows.py. Source: doc_dataset.xlsx = 3,853 scraped Adobe Experience League documentation pages (title/url/content). Each page is cleaned (markdown links/bold, code fences, tables, NOTE/IMPORTANT callouts, anchor slugs and example UUIDs stripped), split on H2/H3 headings, and condensed into PHASE-level paragraphs of 24-56 words that must contain an action verb (create/configure/select/set up/...). Pages that yield between 3 and 12 phases are kept -> 1,301 workflows (saved as t1..tN in workflow_phases.json). Ordered pairs are built WITHIN a workflow between phases at most 2 apart (consecutive + skip-one), in both directions: forward = label 1, reversed = label 0. Identical (text_1, text_2, label) triples are de-duplicated globally with train iterated first, so no eval pair can leak into train. The train/val/test split is document-level 80/10/10 (random seed 42); no URL appears in more than one split. Fields per row: text_1, text_2, label, step_1, step_2, url, title.

how_it_was_created: Sentence-level execution-order builder: src/followup_data/builders/build_workflow_order.py. Source: aep_docs_collection_v_24-03-2026.json, restricted to /tutorials/ pages (step-by-step procedures, not concept overviews). Each tutorial's text is split into sentences; only ACTION steps are kept in transcript order - sentences of 5-60 words that contain an action verb (select/click/navigate/create/enter/configure/...), with narration patterns ('in this video', 'thanks for watching', 'let me...') dropped. Each document's URL slug is mapped to an AJO tier and sub-chapter code (CHAPTER_RULES / SUBCHAPTER_TO_TIER imported from build_classification_data.py). Ordered pairs are built WITHIN a document between steps at most 4 apart (gap <= 4), capped at 60 pairs per document, in both directions: forward = label 1, reversed = label 0. The train/val/test split is document-level 80/10/10 (seed 42). All pairs are intra-document, so tier_1==tier_2 and url_1==url_2. Fields per row: text_1, text_2, label, tier_1, tier_2, sub_1, sub_2, url_1, url_2.
